# Reference links and brackets

This guide uses [a reference][release] beside a collapsed reference [][release], with the definition kept below. It also quotes the literal text \[name\](target) and a Unicode label [東京案内][city]. The examples must retain their destinations and visible text while a document-level fix processes unrelated safe style issues.

[release]: https://example.invalid/releases "Release archive"
[city]: https://example.invalid/tokyo "東京"

The final paragraph keeps a parenthesized note (including [nested](https://example.invalid/nested)) intact.
